About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!

Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Analista de Operações Pleno

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Analista de People Analytics
description:
Sobre a Arcor do Brasil

Somos uma das maiores empresas de alimentos da América Latina, reconhecida por marcas que fazem parte da vida das pessoas. Nosso propósito é levar momentos de sabor e alegria para milhões de consumidores, com inovação, qualidade e responsabilidade social.

Por que essa vaga é especial?

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para fazer parte do time como Analista de People Analytics e nos ajudar a transformar dados em insights estratégicos que impactem diretamente a experiência dos nossos colaboradores e a tomada de decisão da área de Capital Humano. Se você tem interesse por dados, tecnologia e pessoas, essa oportunidade é para você!

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (BI e Analytics), garantindo integridade e consistência dos dados para apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Analisar métricas e tendências para identificar oportunidades e orientar ações críticas da área.
  • Colaborar com todos os subsistemas de RH , apresentando indicadores, testando hipóteses e promovendo uma cultura data-driven.
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico de RH , fornecendo análises e projeções sobre força de trabalho, custos e impacto das políticas.
  • Buscar inovação e automação em soluções analíticas, mantendo-se atualizado sobre melhores práticas em People Analytics.
  • Atuar como elo entre os pilares de Sistema de Gestão Integrada em Capital Humano , garantindo integração e alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Estatística, Engenharia, Ciências de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com indicadores de RH.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel.
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e comunicar resultados de forma clara e estratégica.
  • Desejável conhecimento em VBA.

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza pessoas e acredita no poder dos dados para transformar realidades?

Candidate-se agora e venha construir o futuro com a Arcor do Brasil!

title: Coordenador de produção
description:
A Hunter Douglas, multinacional centenária e líder em cortinas, persianas e soluções arquitetônicas, agora parte do portfólio da 3G Capital, está em busca de novos talentos que queiram fazer parte de uma jornada de inovação e crescimento!

Este profissional será responsável por coordenar a equipe de produção de uma de nossas fábricas, garantir o alinhamento entre as áreas envolvidas no ciclo de planejamento, garantir o envolvimento dos stakeholders e identificar/implementar projetos de melhoria contínua.

Atividades:

  • Coordenar as equipes, visando ao alcance das metas de produção e qualidade no modelo make to order (MTO);
  • Gerenciar o processo de S&OP, facilitar as reuniões e propor ajustes no planejamento conforme mudanças no mercado ou na capacidade de produção;
  • Colaborar com os departamentos de vendas, operações e suprimentos para revisar e ajustar previsões de demanda, planos de produção.
  • Monitorar e implementar os KPIs relacionados ao processo de S&OP, apresentando relatórios à gestão;
  • Identificar gargalos de produção, riscos e oportunidades;
  • Conduzir e reportar inventários regulares de materiais e produtos acabados na planta;
  • Automatizar processos e relatórios e implementar softwares de gestão;
  • Consolidar e apresentar relatórios de faturamento mensal da planta, destacando a performance financeira e o impacto das operações de produção nos resultados globais da empresa.

Requisitos para a posição:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia;
  • Excel avançado com VBA;
  • Conhecimento em S&OP;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas ERP;
  • Familiaridade com o modelo de produção MTO;
  • Habilidades analíticas - foco em dados.

Diferenciais:

  • Inglês e/ou espanhol;
  • Experiência prévia liderando equipes de produção.

title: Coordenador(a) de Food Safety (Temporário)
description:
About the role

Estamos buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Food Safety para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, garantindo a implementação e manutenção dos programas de qualidade e segurança de alimentos na fábrica. Contrato temporário de 9 meses com chance de contratação ao final do contrato.

Key responsibilities

  • Garantir a implementação e manutenção dos programas de Food Safety e Qualidade na fábrica.
  • Promover treinamentos de HACCP para equipe HACCP e demais colaboradores.
  • Coordenar o manejo integrado de pragas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e registrar treinamentos da área de qualidade para todos os colaboradores.
  • Revisar e manter todos os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) da fábrica.
  • Atuar frente às não conformidades encontradas, utilizando ferramentas como 5W2H para análise de causa raiz.
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, bem como planos de ação decorrentes de auditorias, reclamações de clientes ou não conformidades.
  • Gerenciar o sistema de reclamações de clientes.
  • Liderar a equipe HACCP e revisar estudos HACCP.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas governamentais, ambientais e de segurança industrial.

Qualifications and skills

  • Formação preferencial: Engenharia de Alimentos , Química ou Farmácia .
  • Certificações: HACCP , FSSC 22000 (obrigatória).
  • Experiência com auditorias internas e externas (relacionados à qualidade e segurança de alimentos).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de causa raiz (5W2H ).
  • Domínio de SAP e Excel (planilhas de capex, budget).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas globais e protocolos internacionais.
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura de documentação técnica e protocolos globais). Espanhol será considerado diferencial.
  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade analítica.
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com problemas e manter a calma.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Visão prática: presença no chão de fábrica, não apenas atividades administrativas.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Senior Director - LATAM Delivery Head (Payments industry)
description:

  • Relentlessly focuses on identifying & implementing opportunities to improve

  • Full line management responsibility for all team members e.g. Recruitment, performance mgmt., salary decisions etc.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Technology or a related field
  • Proven end to end project leadership experience in the payments industry is mandatory
  • Experience of leading implementations with significant data migrations & integrations involving multiple clients in a virtual, multi-national cross functional team environment
  • Experience of driving continuous improvements in projects/service delivery by identifying root causes, streamlining processes & aligning teams to client expectations
  • Demonstrated ability to build sustainable relationships up to C level with clients
  • Strong communication capabilities to effectively manage up, down & across the enterprise
  • Results orientated with a track record of successful delivery to meet financial targets
  • Strong understanding of delivery financials, forecasting & commercial contracts
  • Proven line management experience, developing high performing teams
  • Excellent written & spoken English and Spanish
  • Availability to work in Campinas on a hybrid mode
  • Flexibility to travel.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.

This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.

This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.

What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Desenvolvedor Unity (Senior)
description:
Vaga PJ- Desenvolvedor Unity (Senior) - 100% Homeoffice

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Unity experiente para atuar em um projeto de evolução da nossa plataforma, especialmente no desenvolvimento de sistemas gamificados, avatares, interações 3D/2D e funcionalidades que conectam tecnologia e comportamento humano.

Procuramos alguém com forte domínio técnico em Unity + C#, experiência em desenvolvimento mobile, criação de fluxos gamificados, animações, otimização e integração com backend.

title: Arquiteto de Software (React Native)
description:
Arquiteto de Software (React Native)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Atuará também na comunicação da solução de forma clara ao time técnico, tomando decisões que facilitem a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos tecnológicos e materializem os objetivos de negócio, sendo responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas de qualidade nos projetos.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Criar visões arquiteturais que comuniquem a solução de forma clara ao time de desenvolvimento;
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em decisões técnicas e estruturais;

  • Apoiar e orientar times de desenvolvimento em decisões arquiteturais;
  • Assegurar que soluções respeitem restrições e atendam atributos de qualidade;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares para garantir excelência técnica e experiência do usuário.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio em React Native (Hooks, Context API, TypeScript, Navigation, Animations, Performance Optimization);
  • Experiência sólida com integrações nativas Android (Java/Kotlin) e iOS (Swift/Objective-C) — criação e manutenção de bridges;

  • Comunicação técnica clara e colaborativa com times multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade de mentorar e influenciar decisões técnicas em múltiplos squads;
  • Perfil investigativo e hands-on, com habilidade para diagnosticar e resolver gargalos complexos;
  • Foco em excelência técnica, segurança e experiência do usuário.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules);
  • Dominar conceitos de arquitetura escalável (DDD, Event-Driven, Hexagonal);
  • Tiver experiência com micro frontends mobile ou arquitetura plugin-based;
  • Possuir conhecimento em segurança mobile avançada (OWASP Mobile, App Attest, biometria, criptografia local);
  • Tiver experiência com análise de performance nativa (Systrace, Perfetto, Instruments).



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office

  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo



Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  • Inscrição
  • Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  • Bate-papo com People

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior Ruby Developer
description:
Location: Remote LATAM

Engagement: Part-time Contractor

Start Date: End of November

Duration: 2 sprints, with strong potential for continued work until June 2026

Schedule: ~25 hours per week


About the Role

We’re looking for a Ruby Specialist with deep experience in Discourse to deliver a fast, clean, and production-ready P1 integration between Discourse and an existing Community application. The integration includes SSO via Okta and OIDC, group and role mapping, backend adapters, shared UI elements, webhook delivery into our analytics stack, and a smooth cutover plan.

This is a high-impact engagement supporting an active squad. You’ll work closely with backend, frontend, security, IT, and data engineering partners to unblock engineers, validate designs, and land the integration safely behind feature flags. If the initial scope goes well, the engagement is expected to extend through mid-2026.

We’re looking for someone proactive, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in a multi-team environment where clarity and speed matter.


Responsibilities
  • Deliver the P1 Discourse to a Community application integration within two sprints
  • Implement SSO using Okta and OIDC, ensuring secure token handling and session flows
  • Create and test group and role mapping between the Community roles and Discourse groups
  • Build backend Ruby adapters for moderation, taxonomy, and role syncing, gated behind feature flags
  • Implement shared header and navigation elements for a consistent cross-platform experience
  • Create and validate webhook pipelines from Discourse into Snowflake for analytics
  • Develop a clear cutover and rollback plan, including checklists and validation steps
  • Write or review technical designs, threat models, and operational readiness docs
  • Pair with frontend and backend engineers to land adapters, UI integration, and test coverage
  • Coordinate closely with Security and IT on Okta configuration, secrets, and access policies
  • Work with Data Engineering to finalize webhook schemas, retries, and observability
  • Support sprint ceremonies, demos, and unblock teammates on integration or Ruby-related work
  • Ensure all deliverables are tested, documented, and ready for production


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse
  • Deep understanding of SSO flows (OIDC, OAuth2, Okta) and secure token handling
  • Proven experience delivering integrations behind feature flags or staged rollouts
  • Comfortable writing technical designs, threat models, and operational runbooks
  • Solid experience with APIs, background jobs, webhooks, and data syncing
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with frontend integration of shared headers or cross-app navigation
  • Prior work in enterprise environments that require coordination across IT, Security, and Data teams
  • Experience building rollback strategies and production cutover plans
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps or infrastructure supporting Ruby services

﻿

Why Join

This is a critical, high-visibility integration that will significantly impact how users navigate between Discourse and the Community platform within a large US company. You’ll collaborate with a focused, friendly, and fast-moving team, and you’ll own a deliverable that immediately impacts thousands of users. The work is scoped, essential, and a strong performer will be invited to continue supporting the platform through June 2026.

If you enjoy solving complex integration puzzles, delivering reliable Ruby code, and helping cross-functional teams move faster, this project is an excellent fit.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Consultor(a) de SAP PLM
description:
Consultor(a) SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) com experiência em migrações de ECC para S/4.

Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição

Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP PLM com experiência comprovada em migrações de ECC para S/4HANA. O candidato ideal deverá ter sólida experiência em processos e integrações do SAP Product Lifecycle Management, garantindo uma transição fluida de dados e processos. A função requer boa comunicação em inglês (nível intermediário ou superior) e capacidade de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais em ambientes globais.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e apoiar migrações de ECC para S/4HANA dentro do domínio PLM.
  • Analisar processos PLM existentes no ECC e projetar soluções otimizadas no S/4.
  • Configurar módulos SAP PLM, incluindo Document Management System (DMS) , Engineering Change Management (ECM) , Product Structure Management e Recipe/Formulation Management .
  • Garantir a integração entre PLM e outros módulos (MM, PP, SD, QM).
  • Definir estratégia de migração, mapeamento e regras de transformação.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais e colaborar com as equipes de ABAP e Basis para desenvolvimentos customizados.
  • Apoiar atividades de migração de dados, validações e reconciliações.
  • Executar testes unitários, testes de integração e apoiar o UAT com usuários-chave de negócio.
  • Oferecer suporte funcional e resolver incidentes durante e após a migração.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e oferecer treinamento aos usuários-chave.
  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile) para execução de projetos.


Requisitos :

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM .
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA .
  • Sólido conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento sobre gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência em ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês intermediário ou superior (oral e escrito).
  • Conhecimento em aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit ).
  • Familiaridade com o SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.
  • Inglês avançado
  • Diferencial: Espanhol


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: AI Engineer | Agents
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Generativa (Generative AI Engineer) para ser uma peça-chave no desenvolvimento e evolução da nossa plataforma de Agentic AI .


Na Bren, não construímos chatbots genéricos. Nosso produto é uma plataforma avançada de múltiplos agentes (vendas, suporte, insights) que orquestra conversas de alta performance no WhatsApp. Você será responsável por projetar, construir e otimizar os "cérebros" por trás dessas interações, transformando dados brutos de conversas em vendas reais e experiências hiper-personalizadas.


Sobre a Bren

A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades

Sua missão será evoluir a inteligência central da nossa plataforma:


  • Desenvolver a Arquitetura Multi-Agente: Projetar, implementar e otimizar os agentes de IA (vendas, suporte, insights) e a "camada de inteligência unificada" que os orquestra.
  • Otimizar a Tomada de Decisão: Desenvolver a lógica que permite aos agentes interagir com sistemas de terceiros (ex: gateways de pagamento, calendários, CRMs) para executar tarefas complexas, como um "Frictionless Shopping Journey" dentro do WhatsApp.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação: Manter-se na vanguarda das técnicas de IA Generativa, testando e implementando novas arquiteturas de agentes, modelos e frameworks para garantir a liderança tecnológica da Bren.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura) para integrar as capacidades de IA de forma escalável e segura na nossa infraestrutura (FastAPI + GCP).


Stack de IA e Ferramentas


  • Linguagem Principal: Python
  • Frameworks de IA: LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares
  • Modelos: Experiência prática com APIs de LLMs e/ou modelos open-source
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com Bancos Vetoriais (Vector Databases) (ex: Pinecone, Chroma, PGVector) e SQL
  • Backend & Infra: FastAPI, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


Perfil Ideal


  • Experiência Central: Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e produção de sistemas de IA Generativa, especialmente com arquiteturas de agentes (Agentic AI) .
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Proficiência em Python e frameworks como LangChain (ou similares).
  • Domínio de RAG: Profundo conhecimento de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , embeddings e o uso de Vector Databases .
  • Visão de Produto: Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios complexos (como vendas conversacionais) em soluções de IA robustas e escaláveis.
  • Infraestrutura: Familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (ou AWS/Azure), especialmente serviços relacionados a AI/ML.
  • Engenharia de Software: Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs (idealmente FastAPI ) e boas práticas de engenharia para colocar modelos em produção.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com a API da Meta (WhatsApp Cloud API) e Whatsapp Flow é um grande diferencial.


Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis, com foco em integração, transformação e governança de dados na plataforma Snowflake.

Projetar e implementar soluções de ingestão e orquestração utilizando Azure Data Factory, Databricks e outras ferramentas do ecossistema Azure.

Integrar dados de diferentes fontes (REST, SOAP, OData APIs), garantindo a qualidade, consistência e performance dos processos.

Modelar dados corporativos com boas práticas de modelagem relacional (E/R, normalização, chaves primárias e estrangeiras).

Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos e engenheiros de dados para desenhar soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta disponibilidade.

Gerenciar componentes da infraestrutura Azure, como Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Logic Apps e Azure Functions.

Colaborar com times globais em ambiente ágil, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL, incluindo transformação, otimização e performance tuning.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados e manipulação de dados semiestruturados (JSON, XML, Parquet).
  • Vivência com CI/CD, GitHub Actions e práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Sólida compreensão da infraestrutura Azure (Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, monitoramento, Azure Functions).
  • Experiência com orquestração e agendamento de jobs (ADF triggers, Logic Apps, FiveTran).
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente internacional.

  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e atuação em times multifuncionais.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Sólida experiência em Oracle Retail, incluindo implementação, customização e integração com sistemas corporativos.

Experiência sólida em Arquitetura, com atuação direta em desenho de soluções Oracle Retail.

Vivência em ambientes Unix/Linux, com automação de processos em lote e criação de scripts de orquestração.

Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções escaláveis Oracle Retail para extração, transformação e carga (ETL) de dados em data warehouses corporativos.

BROKER

QUEM SOMOS:

A Binswanger é uma organização internacional de consultoria imobiliária com mais de 80 anos de tradição. Criada nos Estados Unidos em 1931, a companhia assiste a clientes corporativos em mais de 100 países, nos cinco continentes.

Durante os anos 1990, a consultoria iniciou um programa de expansão internacional, formando alianças estratégicas com organizações imobiliárias em todo o mundo, período em que se estabeleceu também no Brasil, maior mercado imobiliário da América Latina.

Fundada em 1997, a Binswanger Brazil nasceu como escritório regional da rede, e em pouco mais de duas décadas se consolidou como uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços imobiliários para o mercado corporativo brasileiro.

Com sede em São Paulo, a companhia conta atualmente com uma das melhores estruturas imobiliárias em operação no país e oferece assistência de alcance global para todo o território nacional em um balcão único para clientes em diversos setores da economia.

Mais do que atender às necessidades de clientes, a Binswanger Brazil oferece linha completa de soluções imobiliárias e projetos personalizados para atender a todas as etapas dos processos imobiliários de seus parceiros de negócio.

Em 2023 realizamos o que foi um marco significativo para o setor imobiliário, anunciamos a fusão entre a Binswanger Brazil e a SDS Properties. Nossa decisão, motivada pela oportunidade de combinarmos tecnologia, dados, relacionamentos e expertise de equipes altamente referenciadas, buscou potencializar ferramentas, inteligência de mercado, capacidade de inovação e consequentemente apresentar aos nossos clientes o mais alto nível de atendimento em Real Estate do país.

Transações & Assessoria Imobiliária;

Consultoria & Avaliações de Imóveis;

Geo Soluções e Regularização Documental;

Gerenciamento de Projetos e Obras e;

Property e Asset Management.

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing



Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:

Adquadrant is the AI-powered growth partner for modern consumer brands.


We help high-growth companies scale intelligently by transforming data, creative, and media into a connected intelligence system that learns and optimizes every day. Our approach unites four core pillars: Brand Intelligence, Media, Creative, and Measurement, all orchestrated through an AI framework that continuously adapts to performance signals and market shifts. Through this connected model, we have helped next-generation brands generate over a billion dollars in attributable revenue and build lasting momentum in a constantly evolving market. We are seeking a Paid Media Campaign Manager who is comfortable managing cross-channel (Google, YouTube, Meta, TikTok, etc) paid media campaigns for US-based e-commerce and lead generation brands and is fanatical about AI usage to empower better and faster outcomes for clients.. This role is ideal for someone who is both a strategist and an operator, who thrives on solving complex performance challenges, enjoys building from 0 to 1, and knows how to connect data insights to creative opportunities.

Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Pmax, Shopping, Display, YouTube), Meta/Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and Microsoft Ads.

  • Prepare performance reports using GA4, Looker Studio, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, and other attribution platforms.


Strategy & Innovation

Qualifications

  • Experience managing large-scale budgets ($100K+/month) across multiple brands in the english speaking markets (US strongly preferred).

  • Skilled in reporting, visualization, and data storytelling through GA4 and Supermetrics.
  • Excels in environments that value data-driven decisions, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and eager to continuously test and learn.
  • Passionate about media innovation, AI-driven performance insights, and delivering measurable impact.

title: CargoGoogle Ads Specialist - Lead Generation Focus
description:
What We Offer 


Work From Anywhere – 100% remote opportunity with a results-driven global team.

Proven System For Success – No more hitting and hoping. Our battle-tested Google Ads system generates high-quality leads with consistency so you can focus on precision execution and campaign optimization.

Career Development Opportunities – For high performers, there is opportunity to grow into system-building and high-level strategy roles over time.

High-Impact Role – See your work drive results with granular execution and proactive communication.

Elite Team Culture – Join a group of specialists who prioritize precision, data, and high performance.

Paid Time Off As Needed – Take well-deserved breaks whenever you need them.

Who We Are 


Pressure Washing Marketing Pros is a digital marketing agency focused on Google Ads, SEO, and high-converting web design for exterior cleaning companies. By focusing on this niche, we’ve discovered and scaled on repeatable processes that allow us to:


Execute based on data and beat “seat of the pants” traditional strategies.

Deliver predictable, high-quality leads with our proven Google Ads system.

Scale results by constantly testing, refining, and optimizing our paid campaigns.

Our speed, output, and constant improvement help set us apart from our competition.

Your Role & Impact 


As a Google Ads Specialist on our team, you’ll execute and optimize campaigns across 70+ Google Ads accounts and 25+ Local Service Ads accounts. You’ll join our existing Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Specialist who have been with the company for years and who are experts with our system. You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.


Key Responsibilities 


Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ). 

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ). 

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp. 

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ). 

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed 


Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

Great analytical skillset for search term review, budget pacing, and campaign adjustments.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required): 


Experience with Local Service Ads management 

Unbounce 

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail 

What We Value  


Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don’t micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics 


Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan. 

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule 


Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process 


We’re serious about hiring because we’re serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.


The hiring process:  


Application and screening questions. 

Paid trial project with strict QA rubric. 

Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

title: Gerente de CRM e Personalização em Escala – Supervisor(a) de Contas / Estrategista de UX - 100% home office - Inglês avançado
description:
Título do cargo: Gerente de CRM e Personalização em Escala – Supervisor(a) de Contas / Estrategista de UX


Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 09h00 às 18h00 ou das 10h00 às 19h00.



Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.



Objetivo do Cargo:


O(A) Gerente de CRM e Personalização em Escala atua como o elo estratégico entre a visão de engajamento do consumidor e a execução impecável das campanhas . Como líder funcional no design de jornadas e segmentação de audiência, esse profissional é responsável por transformar insights de consumidores e objetivos de negócio em estratégias avançadas de CRM e Fidelidade , abrangendo múltiplos canais e mercados.

Esse cargo define estruturas de comunicação por ciclo de vida , táticas de personalização e lógicas de segmentação que impulsionam a ativação significativa de dados primários (1P data). Inclui também orientar a priorização de jornadas, garantir consistência entre marcas e plataformas e incorporar ciclos de aprendizado contínuos para otimizar o desempenho.

Embora não execute diretamente nas plataformas, o cargo é o proprietário do modelo funcional (blueprint) — garantindo que as campanhas sejam relevantes para o consumidor, orientadas por dados, tecnicamente viáveis e alinhadas aos objetivos comerciais . Além disso, facilita o alinhamento com as equipes de conteúdo, marketing e implantação , conectando todos os insumos necessários para criar jornadas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto nos resultados de negócio .


Principais Responsabilidades:


1) Marketing Direto e Ativação de Audiências

  • Liderar o design e a documentação das jornadas completas de CRM ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do cliente (ex.: aquisição, onboarding, reativação, fidelização), garantindo alinhamento estratégico e viabilidade técnica .
  • Traduzir insights de consumidores e prioridades de marca em lógicas de jornada , definindo gatilhos, tempos de espera, ramificações e metas .
  • Definir e evoluir o roadmap de CRM e Personalização entre marcas e mercados, em linha com as prioridades do setor.
  • Fornecer orientação estratégica às equipes de operação e técnica sobre configuração de jornadas, uso de conteúdo dinâmico e orquestração de mensagens.
  • Ser o responsável funcional pelo (Personalization at Scale) , incorporando sinais comportamentais e contextuais às ativações de CRM.

2) Dados, Mensuração e Otimização

  • Colaborar com as equipes de dados para aproveitar modelos preditivos, sinais comportamentais e oportunidades de enriquecimento de dados primários (1PD) .
  • Definir KPIs e métricas de sucesso para programas de CRM, incluindo engajamento, conversão e incremento de receita.
  • Integrar insights de performance em novas iterações estratégicas, identificando oportunidades de teste e aprendizado e lacunas de desempenho .
  • Trabalhar em parceria com líderes de CDP/CDNA para aprimorar a lógica de segmentação e as táticas de personalização orientadas por dados.

3) Alinhamento Multifuncional e Suporte a Stakeholders

  • Atuar como elo estratégico de CRM para as equipes de marca e mercados locais, aconselhando sobre viabilidade e melhores práticas .
  • Guiar a priorização de jornadas e segmentos de consumidores com base em impacto de negócio, nível de personalização e oportunidade de audiência.


Experiência e Competências Necessárias:


  • 5 a 7 anos de experiência em funções estratégicas de CRM ou Marketing Direto, com expertise comprovada em marketing de ciclo de vida e personalização em escala .
  • Domínio em personalização orientada por dados , design de jornadas complexas e lógica de segmentação .
  • Conhecimento funcional do Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extensions e Triggers), suficiente para orientar equipes de execução.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura CDP/CDNA , lógica de ativação e fluxos de integração de audiências.
  • Familiaridade com mecânicas de fidelidade, jornadas de indicação, estratégias de gamificação e modelos de engajamento similares.
  • Perfil analítico , capaz de interpretar resultados de campanhas e traduzir insights em ajustes estratégicos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e capacidade de sintetizar informações de marca, dados, tecnologia e times globais em estratégias de CRM acionáveis .
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em organizações grandes e matriciais , com ecossistemas de CRM de alto volume.
  • Vivência em CPG (bens de consumo), varejo ou modelos baseados em assinatura .
  • Familiaridade com integrações CRM/adtech (ex.: uso combinado de dados pagos e proprietários para segmentação).
  • Histórico comprovado de melhoria de performance de CRM por meio de comunicações personalizadas e otimização de estratégias.
  • Experiência colaborando no desenvolvimento de templates de jornada , lógicas de decisão e playbooks de personalização .
  • Conhecimento em lógica de UX/CX ou frameworks de comunicação centrados no usuário (não voltados ao design visual).


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.



Como se Candidatar

Os candidatos interessados podem se inscrever enviando seu currículo e carta de apresentação para
